items.proposed: no selection biomarker row (drop A's TNBC ER/PgR/HER2-negative enrichment row)
items.reason: Inclusion defines expansion cohort 2 as 'Patients with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), defined as estrogen receptor (ER) negative ... HER2 negative'; this defines a non-GBM tumour type for that cohort (analogous to IDH-wildtype used only to define GBM) rather than a molecular selection; it does not apply to the GBM cohort and is not candidate-matched either way.

The only candidate eligibility/enrichment marker is the TNBC receptor-negative definition of cohort 2, which is a tumour-type definition, not a molecular selection; the GBM cohort ('Expansion cohort 1: Patients affected by GBM.') has no molecular requirement.

note: Neither the manual nor R1-R8 says whether a receptor-status tumour-type definition of a non-GBM basket cohort (TNBC) counts as an enrichment biomarker. If XL counts it, any_molecular_selection becomes true (primary outcome unaffected: not candidate-matched). Keep consistent with the KIT-in-non-GBM-cohort question in NCT04908176.
